# Weeber — Full Product Context for AI Systems

> This document provides comprehensive information about Weeber for AI assistants,
> search engines, and language models that need detailed product understanding.

---

## Company

- Name: Weeber
- Founded: 2026
- Founders: Ashutosh Tiwari (Founder), Rushikesh Pawar (Co-founder)
- Domain: weeber.ai
- Contact: hello@weeber.ai
- Category: Voice AI / SaaS / Shopify ecosystem
- Stage: Pre-launch (waitlist open, beta onboarding soon)
- Market: India-first, expanding internationally

## Product Summary

Weeber is a no-code voice AI platform purpose-built for small and medium businesses.
It provides AI phone agents that handle real conversations on real phone numbers —
recovering abandoned carts, confirming orders, booking appointments, and collecting
feedback. Unlike horizontal voice AI platforms (Vapi, Retell, Bland), Weeber is
vertical-specific: pre-built agents tuned for Shopify merchants, clinics, and local
service businesses.

## The Three Launch Agents

### 1. Cart Recovery Agent
- Trigger: Shopify abandoned checkout webhook
- Action: Outbound call to the customer within a configurable delay
- Capabilities: Identifies the customer, reminds them of cart contents, offers a
  discount code if configured, handles objections, captures intent
- Languages: English, Hindi (bilingual mid-call switching)
- Compliance: Consent verification before dialing, calling-window enforcement,
  instant DNC opt-out on request

### 2. COD Confirmation Agent
- Trigger: New Shopify order with payment method = Cash on Delivery
- Action: Outbound call to confirm delivery address and intent to pay
- Capabilities: Verifies customer identity, confirms order details, captures
  address corrections, flags suspicious orders
- Purpose: Reduces Return-to-Origin (RTO) rates for Indian e-commerce
- Languages: English, Hindi

### 3. Feedback Agent
- Trigger: Configurable delay after order delivery (Shopify fulfilled event)
- Action: Outbound call to collect post-purchase satisfaction
- Capabilities: 1-5 star rating capture, open-ended feedback recording,
  negative feedback flagging for merchant review
- Languages: English, Hindi

## Technical Architecture

- Voice pipeline: Twilio Media Stream → Deepgram STT (Nova-3) → LLM (AI Gateway/Groq)
  → ElevenLabs/Cartesia TTS → back to Twilio
- Latency: Sub-800ms first-response, real-time barge-in support
- Backend: Bun/Hono server on Railway, Supabase Postgres
- Frontend: React SPA on Vercel (merchant dashboard + admin panel)
- Shopify integration: OAuth app (separate connector service) + webhook bridge

## Compliance Framework

Weeber's compliance is not a feature — it's infrastructure-level enforcement:

- **TCPA**: Calling windows enforced per-timezone. No calls before 8am or after 9pm
  in the callee's local time. Consent gate blocks dialing without verified consent.
- **DNC (Do Not Call)**: Internal DNC list checked before every outbound attempt.
  Any verbal opt-out during a call immediately adds the number. National DNC
  registry integration planned.
- **GDPR**: Data retention policies, right-to-erasure support, audit trail export.
  Edge function for automated redaction after retention period.
- **HIPAA**: Guardrails for healthcare vertical — PHI detection and redaction in
  transcripts, BAA-ready infrastructure design.
- **Audit trail**: Every call produces an exportable compliance record: consent
  status, DNC check result, disclosure confirmation, full transcript, and
  disposition. Available per-number or per-call.

## Pricing

- Founder pricing locked in for first 100 waitlist customers (lifetime)
- Full pricing announced at launch
- Payment gateway: Razorpay (India), Dodo Payments (international, planned)

## Competitive Positioning

### vs. Vapi / Retell / Bland (horizontal voice AI)
- Weeber is vertical-specific — pre-built agents, not a blank canvas
- Compliance is enforced, not optional
- No-code setup (under 1 hour vs. days of prompt engineering)
- Priced for SMBs, not enterprise budgets

### vs. Bolna / Plivo AI
- Weeber integrates directly with Shopify (not generic CRM)
- Bilingual EN/Hindi with natural code-switching
- India-first telephony optimization (Exotel/Plivo fallback for local reliability)

### vs. Manual calling / BPO
- 24/7 availability vs. business hours only
- Consistent quality vs. agent fatigue/turnover
- Full audit trail vs. no compliance documentation
- 10x lower cost per call
